full_reasoning: <think>My reasoning must be all lowercase letters. I will first break down the process of how mrna vaccines work. when the vaccine is injected into the body, the mrna enters the cells. the cells use the mrna to produce a viral protein, like the spike protein of the coronavirus. this protein is then displayed on the cell surface. the immune system recognizes this protein as foreign and starts an immune response. the body produces antibodies and t-cells that can attack the virus if encountered in the future. the mrna is degraded after the protein is made, so it doesn't stay in the body long. this process helps the body build immunity without causing the disease.
final_answer: when an mrna vaccine is injected, the mrna enters the cells. the cells use the mrna to make a harmless piece of the virus, like the spike protein. this protein is displayed on the cell surface, alerting the immune system. the immune system then produces antibodies and t-cells to fight the virus. the mrna is broken down after the protein is made, so it doesn't stay in the body. this prepares the body to recognize and fight the actual virus if exposed later.
